resources.string: Active tiles: your recently used apps showing the content of their latest notification, like BlackBerry Active Frames.

Optional: so the tiles can show a real image of an app\'s last state (like BlackBerry Active Frames), Active Frames takes a screenshot of an app when you open it. The images stay only on the device (app-private storage) and are never sent anywhere. Without this, tiles show the latest notification image or the app icon.
No tiles yet – grant usage access in Active Frames.
Active tiles of your recently used apps – top left is the most recently opened, like BlackBerry OS10. Red star when there is something new, tile image from the latest notification.
Needs usage access (which app was in front most recently).
Needs notification access (latest image / “new” per app).

Without this, tiles show the latest notification image or the app icon. With accessibility enabled, Active Frames takes a photo of an app\'s state when you open it (true Active Frames look). Images stay on the device only; secure apps (banking) stay black.
Place the widget on your home screen (long-press an empty spot → Widgets → Active Frames) and resize it freely. Columns, tile format and quick-launch apps are in the gear.
Match tile format to the screen automatically
Tile height (dp) – smaller = more visible (only when not automatic)
Large rows on top (rows after are smaller)
The widget is freely resizable – long-press it on the home screen and drag the edges. Tile image = content of the latest notification (photo/cover), otherwise the app icon.
